newsitem.title: USA: No evidence of U.S. inflation pressures - Stiglitz.
newsitem.headline: No evidence of U.S. inflation pressures - Stiglitz.

text.p: Joseph Stiglitz, chairman of the Council of Economic Advisers, said on Monday he currently sees no evidence of inflationary pressures in the U.S. economy.
"We don't see any pressures for inflation acceleration at the current time," said Stiglitz, speaking to reporters at a National Association of Business Economists conference in Boston.
Stiglitz also said wages had more room to rise without spurring inflation.
"Wages have been at a level ... that does not represent an inflationary threat given the level of productivity and underlying rates of inflation," he said.
"So there is considerable room on that score alone for wage increases ... There are some cushions here before we get into wage increases that are likely to be a threat to inflation," Stiglitz added.
